7.2.3.5 Handling Method Calls
The RPC over DDS Specification (DDS-RPC) [24] introduces the concept of DDS Ser-
vices. These Services provide the mechanisms required to define and implement
methods that can be invoked remotely by DDS “client” applications using the build-
ing blocks of the DDS data-centric publish-subscribe middleware [21]. In this section,
we specify how to handle ara::com method calls over DDS by defining the appropriate
mapping between ara::com service methods and DDS service methods.
